title: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020 - Rule 4: Duties of Marketplace E-Commerce Entities
text: Marketplace e-commerce entities shall display clear details about return, refund, exchange, delivery, shipment, modes of payment, grievance redressal mechanism, and seller details to consumers.
tags: Mandates transparency and disclosure obligations for online marketplace platforms.

metadata.legal_purpose: Mandates transparency and disclosure obligations for online marketplace platforms.

title: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020 - Rule 5: Liabilities of Marketplace E-Commerce Entities
text: No marketplace e-commerce entity shall adopt any unfair trade practice, whether in the course of the offer on its platform or otherwise, and shall ensure that grievance officers acknowledge receipt of consumer complaints within 48 hours and redress them within one month.
tags: Establishes grievance resolution timelines and prohibits deceptive e-commerce sales algorithms.

metadata.legal_purpose: Establishes grievance resolution timelines and prohibits deceptive e-commerce sales algorithms.

title: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020 - Rule 6: Duties of Sellers on Marketplace E-Commerce Platforms
text: No seller offering goods or services through a marketplace e-commerce entity shall adopt any unfair trade practice or refuse to take back goods or refuse to refund consideration if such goods or services are defective, deficient, or spurious.
tags: Duties of Sellers on Marketplace E-Commerce Platforms
Prohibits third-party sellers on platforms from denying returns for defective or missing goods.

metadata.legal_purpose: Prohibits third-party sellers on platforms from denying returns for defective or missing goods.

title: Consumer Protection (Mediation) Rules, 2020 - Rule 3 & 4: Matters Not to be Referred to Mediation
text: Specifies consumer disputes involving serious fraud, fabrication of documents, forgery, or criminal offenses that cannot be referred to voluntary mediation cells attached to Consumer Commissions.
tags: Matters Not to be Referred to Mediation
Establishes legal boundaries for pre-litigation consumer dispute settlement.

metadata.legal_purpose: Establishes legal boundaries for pre-litigation consumer dispute settlement.

title: Consumer Protection (Mediation) Rules, 2020 - Rule 5: Procedure for Mediation Settlement
text: Mandates that mediated settlement agreements signed by consumer parties shall be reduced to writing and submitted to the District, State, or National Commission for passing a final consent decree.
tags: Enforces legal enforceability of pre-trial consumer dispute settlements.

metadata.legal_purpose: Enforces legal enforceability of pre-trial consumer dispute settlements.

title: Consumer Protection (Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions) Rules, 2020 - Rule 3 & 4: Pecuniary Jurisdiction Limits
text: Defines the financial limits of complaints for District Commissions (up to ₹50 Lakhs), State Commissions (₹50 Lakhs to ₹2 Crores), and National Commission (exceeding ₹2 Crores).
tags: Consumer Protection (Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions) Rules, 2020
Establishes clear statutory forum jurisdiction for filing consumer complaints.

metadata.act_or_document_name: Consumer Protection (Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions) Rules, 2020
metadata.legal_purpose: Establishes clear statutory forum jurisdiction for filing consumer complaints.

title: Consumer Protection (Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions) Rules, 2020 - Rule 7: Deposit of Mandatory Appeal Amount
text: Requires an appellant filing an appeal against a District Commission order before a State Commission to deposit 50% of the awarded amount or ₹25,000, whichever is less.
tags: Consumer Protection (Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions) Rules, 2020
Prevents frivolous appeals by opposite parties seeking to delay payment of consumer relief.

metadata.act_or_document_name: Consumer Protection (Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions) Rules, 2020
metadata.legal_purpose: Prevents frivolous appeals by opposite parties seeking to delay payment of consumer relief.

title: Consumer Protection (Direct Selling) Rules, 2021 - Rule 5 & 6: Obligations of Direct Selling Entities and Direct Sellers
text: Prohibits pyramid schemes, money circulation schemes, and mandates mandatory cooling-off periods and refund rights for direct sales to consumers.
tags: Obligations of Direct Selling Entities and Direct Sellers
Protects consumers against multi-level marketing (MLM) fraud and forced non-refundable product packages.

metadata.legal_purpose: Protects consumers against multi-level marketing (MLM) fraud and forced non-refundable product packages.
